# ET-TALIBI

> Digital systems architecture and full-stack engineering — SaaS platforms, mobile applications, workflow automation, and custom business software built for long-term performance.

ET-TALIBI is a portfolio and engineering showcase by a senior architect focused on scalable web and mobile systems.

- [Home](https://ettalibi.com/) — overview, expertise, featured projects, and insights
- [About](https://ettalibi.com/about) — background, approach, and engineering philosophy
- [Projects](https://ettalibi.com/projects) — full project catalog with descriptions and tags
- [Contact](https://ettalibi.com/contact) — get in touch for inquiries
- [Work: Operational Intelligence](https://ettalibi.com/work/operational-intelligence) — case study
- [Work: SaaS Platform](https://ettalibi.com/work/saas-platform) — case study
- [Privacy Policy](https://ettalibi.com/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://ettalibi.com/terms)

## Guidelines

- Crawl public pages only — do not access `/login`, `/dashboard`, or `/api`
- Content is bilingual (English and French)
- Project images are served as optimized WebP via the API
